text.p: These are the leading stories in Zimbabwe's state-owned Herald newspaper on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Delegates to the World Solar Summit which ended in the Zimbabwean capital Harare on Tuesday expressed hope that there would soon be an impetus in the implementation of solar energy projects after the adoption of the Harare Declaration and the World Solar Programme.

- Giant steps in attempts to find meaningful solutions to the global problems of poverty and environmental degradation were taken in Harare on Tuesday with political leaders adopting the Harare Declaration on solar energy and sustainable development at the close of a two-day world solar summit.

- Zimbabwe and Italy on Tuesday signed a Z$250 million commodity imput programme agreement which will provide foreign currency to procure Italian goods and services for Zimbabwe's private and public sectors.
